Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar4` self-updates via element-arithmetic `(int)(pCVar4 + N) + M`, where `N*sizeof(*pCVar4) + M` equals the larger struct stride being walked (the pointer is typed to a sub-element). Replace `pCVar4->field` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.

Replace `local_1c->field` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
Ghidra mistranslated a Watcom float bit-pattern compare as `(int)x`. Hex 0x3f800000 is the IEEE 754 bit pattern of 1f. Rewrite in a .keep as a plain float compare against 1f.
